meta.title: Exchange Online mail flow (transport) rule catalog

availabilityValues.legacy: Works in Exchange Online but superseded; offer behind an advanced toggle.
availabilityValues.reserved: Parameter exists in Exchange Online but is reserved for internal Microsoft use.
availabilityValues.dlpOnPremOnly: Accepted by the cmdlet but functional only in on-premises Exchange DLP.

valueTypes.none: Presence-only predicate or switch-like action; the cmdlet takes $true (no user input).
valueTypes.addresses: One or more recipients (mailbox, mail user, mail contact, Microsoft 365 group); RecipientIdParameter[]; comma-separated in PowerShell.
valueTypes.groups: One or more distribution groups, mail-enabled security groups or Microsoft 365 groups (RecipientIdParameter[]).
valueTypes.betweenGroups: Two group lists that must be set together (BetweenMemberOf1 + BetweenMemberOf2).
valueTypes.managerOf: EvaluatedUser enum (Sender|Recipient) plus one or more manager addresses.
valueTypes.words: Array of words/phrases (Word[]); whole-word, case-insensitive, no wildcards; '*' and '@' are literal.
valueTypes.patterns: Array of regular expressions (Pattern[]); case-insensitive; see regex notes.
valueTypes.domains: Array of SMTP domains; matches the domain and its subdomains.
valueTypes.scope: Single enum value describing internal vs external (FromUserScope or ToUserScope).
valueTypes.adAttributeWords: Array of 'Attribute:word1,word2' strings; Attribute from the ADAttribute enum; all values ORed.
valueTypes.adAttributePatterns: Array of 'Attribute:regex1,regex2' strings; Attribute from the ADAttribute enum.
valueTypes.adComparison: ADAttribute enum plus Evaluation enum (Equal|NotEqual) comparing sender and recipient.
valueTypes.ipRanges: Array of IPv4 entries: single address, a-b range, or CIDR.
valueTypes.size: ByteQuantifiedSize, e.g. '20 MB'; units B, KB, MB, GB, TB; EAC only offers KB.
valueTypes.headerWords: Header name (single string) plus Word[] to find in that header's value.
valueTypes.headerPatterns: Header name (single string) plus Pattern[] to match in that header's value.
valueTypes.documentPropertyWords: Array of 'PropertyName:word1,word2' strings over attached Office document properties.
valueTypes.sensitiveInfoTypes: Array of hashtables like @{Name='Credit Card Number'; minCount='2'} (DLP; not functional in Exchange Online).
valueTypes.supervisionList: Live@edu supervision list value (Allow|Block); reserved for internal Microsoft use in Exchange Online.
valueTypes.html: Single string that may contain HTML, inline CSS and IMG tags, plus %%tokens%%.
valueTypes.headerNameValue: Header name plus header value (SetHeaderName + SetHeaderValue).
valueTypes.smtpStatusCode: Integer SMTP status code 400-500 (Edge Transport only).
valueTypes.enumMulti: One or more values from enumValues (comma-separated in PowerShell).
valueTypes.rmsTemplate: Single RMS / sensitivity encryption template identity (Get-RMSTemplate).
valueTypes.dateTime: DateTime; culture short date, optionally with time.

conditions.eacPath: The sender > is this person
conditions.notes: Mailboxes, mail users, mail contacts or Microsoft 365 groups. Honors SenderAddressLocation (Header, Envelope, HeaderOrEnvelope).

conditions.eacPath: The sender > is external/internal
conditions.notes: Inside = authenticated connection and a recipient object or authoritative/internal-relay accepted domain. Mail contacts are judged by accepted domains.

conditions.eac: The sender is a member of
conditions.eacPath: The sender > is a member of this group
conditions.notes: Group membership is cached ~3 h (no SLA); dynamic DG membership can lag 24 h + 3 h. Honors SenderAddressLocation (Header, Envelope, HeaderOrEnvelope).

conditions.eacPath: The sender > address includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces. Honors SenderAddressLocation (Header, Envelope, HeaderOrEnvelope).

conditions.eacPath: The sender > address matches any of these text patterns
conditions.notes: Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax. Empty From addresses can't be matched. Honors SenderAddressLocation (Header, Envelope, HeaderOrEnvelope).

conditions.eac: The sender is on a recipient's list
conditions.eacPath: The sender > is on a recipient's supervision list
conditions.notes: Live@edu supervision lists; can't be configured in Microsoft 365. Cmdlet docs: reserved for internal Microsoft use. Type is Word[] in the cmdlet. Hide in UI.

conditions.eac: The sender's specified properties include any of these words
conditions.eacPath: The sender > has specific properties including any of these words
conditions.notes: Syntax 'City:San Francisco,Palo Alto','Department:Sales'. Attributes and values ORed. Country needs ISO 3166-1 two-letter code. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eac: The sender's specified properties match these text patterns
conditions.eacPath: The sender > has specific properties matching these text patterns
conditions.notes: Syntax 'Attribute:regex1,regex2'. Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eac: Sender's IP address is in the range
conditions.eacPath: The sender > IP address is in any of these ranges or exactly matches
conditions.notes: IPv4 single, range (a-b) or CIDR. Evaluated against the last hop before Exchange Online, not necessarily the original sender. Conceptual doc spells it SenderIPRanges; cmdlet spells it SenderIpRanges (PowerShell is case-insensitive). Type MultiValuedProperty.

conditions.eacPath: The sender > domain is
conditions.notes: Matches the domain and its subdomains. Cmdlet type Word[]. Honors SenderAddressLocation (Header, Envelope, HeaderOrEnvelope).

conditions.eacPath: The recipient > is this person
conditions.notes: Mailbox, mail user or mail contact in To/Cc/Bcc. Groups can't be used (DGs are expanded before rules run); use AnyOfToHeader/AnyOfCcHeader/AnyOfToCcHeader or SentToMemberOf instead. Honors RecipientAddressType.

conditions.eacPath: The recipient > is external/internal
conditions.notes: ExternalPartner/ExternalNonPartner are on-premises only; offer only InOrganization/NotInOrganization for Exchange Online. Remote domains with IsInternal=$true count as inside. Conceptual doc EAC text says 'is external/external' (typo).

conditions.eac: The recipient is a member of
conditions.eacPath: The recipient > is a member of this group
conditions.notes: Group membership cache ~3 h. If the group is deleted after the rule is created, the predicate no longer applies.

conditions.eacPath: The recipient > address includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Primary address only, not proxies. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: The recipient > address matches any of these text patterns
conditions.notes: Primary address only, not proxies. Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eac: The recipient is on the sender's list
conditions.eacPath: The recipient > is on the sender's supervision list
conditions.notes: Live@edu supervision lists; reserved for internal Microsoft use. Hide in UI.

conditions.eac: The recipient's specified properties include any of these words
conditions.eacPath: The recipient > has specific properties including any of these words
conditions.notes: Individual users only, not distribution groups. Country needs ISO 3166-1 two-letter code. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eac: The recipient's specified properties match these text patterns
conditions.eacPath: The recipient > has specific properties matching these text patterns
conditions.notes: Individual users only. Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eacPath: The recipient > domain is
conditions.notes: Matches the domain and its subdomains. Cmdlet type Word[].

conditions.eacPath: The subject or body > subject or body includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Cmdlet: max length 128 characters. Header text is matched after MIME decoding. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: The subject or body > subject or body matches these text patterns
conditions.notes: Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eacPath: The subject or body > subject includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Cmdlet: max length 128 characters. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: The subject or body > subject matches these text patterns
conditions.notes: Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > content includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Supported file types only (see inspect-message-attachments). Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > content matches these text patterns
conditions.notes: Only the first 150 KB of attachment content is scanned (conditions page and cmdlet). Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eac: Any attachment's content can't be inspected
conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > content can't be inspected
conditions.notes: Fires when an attachment's file type isn't supported for content inspection. Cmdlet type Boolean ($true).

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > file name matches these text patterns
conditions.notes: Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > file extension includes these words
conditions.notes: Extensions without the dot (e.g. exe,js). Nested attachment extensions are inspected too; use Test-TextExtraction to see what was evaluated. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eac: Any attachment is greater than or equal to
conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > size is greater than or equal to
conditions.notes: Embedded (inline) images count as attachments, so tiny values catch ordinary mail. Unqualified values are bytes; small values may round up to KB.

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > didn't complete scanning
conditions.notes: Rules-engine scanning limit only; unrelated to Defender Safe Attachments. Cmdlet type Boolean ($true).

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > has executable content
conditions.notes: Inspects file properties, not the extension. Cmdlet type Boolean ($true).

conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > is password protected
conditions.notes: Detects Office documents, .zip, .7z and .pdf. Cmdlet type Boolean ($true).

conditions.eac: Any attachment has these properties, including any of these words
conditions.eacPath: Any attachment > has these properties, including any of these words
conditions.notes: Syntax 'PropertyName:word1,word2'. enumValues are the built-in properties; custom property names are also allowed (UI should allow free text). Properties and values ORed. For FCI/SharePoint/third-party classification.

conditions.eacPath: Any recipient > address includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Looks in To, Cc and Bcc. Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Primary address only. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: Any recipient > address matches any of these text patterns
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Primary address only. Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

conditions.eacPath: The message > To box contains this person
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Matches primary SMTP address only, not proxy addresses. EAC picker can't select Microsoft 365 groups; type the group address and use Check names. Works with a group address in To.

conditions.eac: The To box contains a member of
conditions.eacPath: The message > To box contains a member of this group
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients.

conditions.eacPath: The message > Cc box contains this person
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Matches primary SMTP address only, not proxy addresses. EAC picker can't select Microsoft 365 groups; type the group address and use Check names.

conditions.eac: The Cc box contains a member of
conditions.eacPath: The message > Cc box contains a member of this group
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Conceptual doc EAC path omits 'Cc box' ('The message > contains a member of this group').

conditions.eac: The To or Cc box contains
conditions.eacPath: The message > To or Cc box contains this person
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients. Recommended way to target a distribution group recipient (doesn't see Bcc). Matches primary SMTP address only, not proxy addresses. EAC picker can't select Microsoft 365 groups; type the group address and use Check names.

conditions.eac: The To or Cc box contains a member of
conditions.eacPath: The message > To or Cc box contains a member of this group
conditions.notes: Affects ALL recipients of the message (current fork) when any recipient matches; as an exception it suppresses the action for all recipients.

conditions.eac: The message size is greater than or equal to
conditions.eacPath: The message > size is greater than or equal to
conditions.notes: Message plus attachments. Mailbox size limits are enforced before rule actions, so oversize mail may bounce first.

conditions.eac: The message character set name includes any of these words
conditions.eacPath: The message > character set name includes any of these words
conditions.notes: EAC shows 'Language/charset'. PowerShell value is believed to be the charset name (e.g. iso-2022-jp); docs don't say explicitly. Source lists 'Japanese/iso-022-jp', corrected here to iso-2022-jp. The list is 'for example', not exhaustive; allow free text.

conditions.eac: The sender is one of the recipient's
conditions.eacPath: The sender and the recipient > the sender's relationship to a recipient is
conditions.notes: Manager = sender manages a recipient; DirectReport = a recipient manages the sender. Uses the Manager attribute.

conditions.eac: The message is between members of these groups
conditions.eacPath: The sender and the recipient > the message is between members of these groups
conditions.notes: Both group lists are required together. Classic 'ethical wall' predicate.

conditions.eac: The manager of the sender or recipient is
conditions.eacPath: The sender and the recipient > the manager of the sender or recipient is this person
conditions.notes: Conceptual doc names the companion 'ManagerAddress'; the cmdlet parameter is ManagerAddresses. Both parameters are required together.

conditions.eac: The sender's and any recipient's property compares as
conditions.eacPath: The sender and the recipient > the sender and recipient property compares as
conditions.notes: Individual users only, not distribution groups.

conditions.eacPath: The message properties > include the message type
conditions.notes: AutoForward does NOT match mailbox (SMTP) forwarding. Encrypted isn't detected for thin clients such as Outlook on the web.

conditions.eacPath: The message properties > include this classification
conditions.notes: Custom message classification (New-MessageClassification), not a DLP/sensitivity label. Pass @(Get-MessageClassification 'Name').Identity.

conditions.eac: The message isn't marked with any classifications
conditions.eacPath: The message properties > don't include any classification
conditions.notes: Cmdlet type Boolean; $true = no classification.

conditions.eac: The message importance is set to
conditions.eacPath: The message properties > include the importance level
A message header > includes any of these words
conditions.notes: Header name and words always used together. Matching is after MIME decoding (can't match raw Base64). Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. No leading or trailing spaces.

conditions.eacPath: A message header > matches these text patterns
conditions.notes: Header name and patterns always used together. Regex, case-insensitive. Counts toward the 20 KB org-wide ContainsWords/MatchesPatterns character budget. UseLegacyRegex switches to Exchange 2010 syntax.

Matches SCL >= value. Listed as applicable to Exchange Online by the cmdlet but absent from the Exchange Online conditions page/EAC (Exchange Server EAC calls it 'The message properties > include an SCL greater than or equal to'). In Exchange Online SCL doesn't determine the verdict, and rules may run before SCL is final; treat as advanced/unreliable.
Hashtable[] e.g. @{Name='Credit Card Number'; minCount='2'}. Cmdlet: functional only in on-premises Exchange; use Microsoft Purview DLP policies in Microsoft 365. Do not offer for Exchange Online.

conditions.eac: The sender has overridden the Policy Tip
conditions.notes: DLP Policy Tip override. Cmdlet: functional only in on-premises Exchange. Do not offer for Exchange Online.

actions.eac: Forward the message for approval to
actions.eacPath: Forward the message for approval > to these people
actions.notes: Moderators get the message wrapped in an approval request. No distribution groups. Max 10 moderators. Pending approvals expire after 2 days (processed every 7 days).

actions.eac: Forward the message for approval to the sender's manager
actions.eacPath: Forward the message for approval > to the sender's manager
actions.notes: If the sender's Manager attribute is empty the message is delivered without moderation.

actions.eac: Redirect the message to
actions.eacPath: Redirect the message to > these recipients
actions.notes: Original recipients don't get it; no notification. Distribution groups can't be added as recipients. Counts toward the 100-recipients-added-per-message limit. Forwardee limit 10 recipients (more and the rule can't apply); a message can be redirected by rules only once.

actions.eac: Deliver the message to the hosted quarantine
actions.eacPath: Redirect the message to > hosted quarantine
actions.notes: Rule evaluation stops after this rule; on release from quarantine the remaining rules are not evaluated.

actions.eac: Use the following connector
actions.eacPath: Redirect the message to > the following connector
actions.notes: Cloud only. Identify by name, DN or GUID (Get-OutboundConnector).

actions.eac: Reject the message with the explanation
actions.eacPath: Block the message > reject the message and include an explanation
actions.notes: NDR to sender. Cloud max 1024 characters (on-prem 256). Default DSN 5.7.1.

actions.eac: Reject the message with the enhanced status code
actions.eacPath: Block the message > reject the message with the enhanced status code of
actions.notes: Valid 5.7.1 or 5.7.900-5.7.999. Custom NDR text per code via New-SystemMessage. Same underlying action as RejectMessageReasonText; a UI can merge them into one 'Reject' action with two fields.

actions.eac: Delete the message without notifying anyone
actions.eacPath: Block the message > delete the message without notifying anyone
actions.notes: Silent drop; prevents later rules from applying.

actions.eac: Add recipients to the Bcc box
actions.eacPath: Add recipients > to the Bcc box
actions.notes: Distribution groups can't be added as recipients. Counts toward the 100-recipients-added-per-message limit.

actions.eac: Add recipients to the To box
actions.eacPath: Add recipients > to the To box
actions.notes: Distribution groups can't be added as recipients. Counts toward the 100-recipients-added-per-message limit.

actions.eac: Add recipients to the Cc box
actions.eacPath: Add recipients > to the Cc box
actions.notes: Distribution groups can't be added as recipients. Counts toward the 100-recipients-added-per-message limit.

actions.eac: Add the sender's manager as a recipient
actions.eacPath: Add recipients > add the sender's manager as a recipient
actions.notes: Needs the sender's Manager attribute. Redirect delivers only to the manager, silently. Cmdlet type AddedRecipientType (doc page shows a 'Cco' typo for Bcc).

actions.group: Apply a disclaimer to the message
actions.eac: Append the disclaimer
actions.eacPath: Apply a disclaimer to the message > append a disclaimer
actions.notes: Max 5000 characters incl. tags; HTML, inline CSS and IMG allowed. Sender tokens: %%City%%, %%Company%%, %%CountryOrRegion%%, %%Department%%, %%DisplayName%%, %%Fax%%, %%FirstName%%, %%HomePhone%%, %%Initials%%, %%LastName%%, %%Manager%%, %%MobilePhone%%, %%Notes%%, %%Office%%, %%Pager%%, %%Phone%%, %%PostalCode%%, %%PostOfficeBox%%, %%StateOrProvince%%, %%StreetAddress%%, %%Title%%, %%UserPrincipalName%%, %%WindowsEmailAddress%%. Fallback Wrap wraps the original as an attachment (if wrapping fails the message is NDR'd); cmdlet advises not using Wrap for inbound external mail in Microsoft 365 (use Reject). Add an exception for a unique disclaimer phrase so replies don't stack disclaimers.

actions.group: Apply a disclaimer to the message
actions.eac: Prepend the disclaimer
actions.eacPath: Apply a disclaimer to the message > prepend a disclaimer
actions.notes: Same as Append with ApplyHtmlDisclaimerLocation=Prepend. Only one disclaimer action per rule (single ApplyHtmlDisclaimerText parameter).

actions.eac: Remove this header
actions.eacPath: Modify the message properties > remove a message header

actions.eac: Set the message header to this value
actions.eacPath: Modify the message properties > set a message header
actions.notes: Adds or overwrites the header. Name and value required together. One header per rule (use multiple rules for several headers).

actions.eac: Apply a message classification
actions.eacPath: Modify the message properties > apply a message classification
actions.notes: Custom message classification, not a DLP/sensitivity label.

actions.eac: Set the spam confidence level (SCL) to
actions.eacPath: Modify the message properties > set the spam confidence level (SCL)
actions.notes: In Exchange Online an input to filtering, not a verdict: -1 requests bypass of most spam filtering, 5/6 spam, 9 high confidence spam; stamped SCL may differ. Doesn't apply to intra-org mail.

actions.eac: Apply Office 365 Message Encryption and rights protection
actions.eacPath: Modify the message security > Message Encryption and rights protection
actions.notes: Purview Message Encryption / RMS template (e.g. 'Encrypt', 'Do Not Forward'); list with Get-RMSTemplate. Optional OME branding template.

actions.eac: Require TLS encryption
actions.eacPath: Modify the message security > require TLS encryption
actions.notes: Forces outbound delivery over TLS.

actions.eac: Encrypt the messages with the previous version of OME
actions.eacPath: Modify the message security > Apply the previous version of OME
actions.notes: Legacy OME; only for tenants not moved to Purview Message Encryption. Fails if IRM licensing isn't enabled. Prefer ApplyRightsProtectionTemplate.

actions.eac: Remove the previous version of OME from the message
actions.eacPath: Modify the message security > Remove the previous version of OME
actions.notes: Internal (intra-org) messages only.

actions.eac: Remove Office 365 Message Encryption and rights protection
actions.eacPath: Modify the message security > Message Encryption and rights protection
actions.notes: Removes Purview Message Encryption / RMS template.
Cloud only, cmdlet only. Decrypts attachments that were encrypted before attaching. Requires RemoveOMEv2 $true in the same rule.

actions.eac: Prepend the subject of the message with
actions.notes: End with a space or colon. Add an ExceptIfSubjectContainsWords exception with the same text to avoid stacking on replies.

actions.eac: Generate incident report and send it to
actions.notes: Exactly one report recipient. Message ID always included; recipient lists capped at first 10. Runs even in Audit and AuditAndNotify modes. Not generated for notifications or other incident reports.

actions.eac: Notify the recipient with a message
actions.notes: Max 5120 characters; text, HTML and tokens %%From%%, %%To%%, %%Cc%%, %%Subject%%, %%Headers%%, %%MessageDate%%. Each matched recipient gets a separate notification. Runs in AuditAndNotify, not in Audit.

actions.eac: Notify the sender with a Policy Tip
actions.notes: DLP only; requires MessageContainsDataClassifications; internal senders only. Cmdlet: functional only in on-premises Exchange. The EXO 'Test a mail flow rule' page still mentions this action; treat as unavailable.
Edge Transport only (on-premises). Disconnects the sending server with SMTP code 400-500.
Edge Transport only. Ends the SMTP session silently.
Edge Transport only. Writes Application event 4000 (MSExchange Messaging Policies).
Exchange 2013 only, deprecated. Use IncidentReportContent AttachOriginalMail.

properties.name: Name
properties.notes: Mandatory on New-TransportRule (position 1). Max 64 characters, unique.

properties.name: Identity
properties.notes: Selects an existing rule by name, DN or GUID. Not on New-TransportRule.

properties.name: Priority
properties.notes: 0 = highest. Existing rules: 0..N-1; new rule: 0..N, default N (last). Setting a taken value shifts that rule and those below down by 1. EAC: move up/down.

properties.name: Mode
properties.notes: Audit: logs to message trace, GenerateIncidentReport still runs. AuditAndNotify: also runs GenerateNotification. Policy Tips themselves need NotifySender, which is on-premises DLP only.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.notes: Only on New-TransportRule. Existing rules: Enable-TransportRule / Disable-TransportRule. Read back as the State property (Enabled/Disabled).

properties.name: ActivationDate
properties.eac: Activate this rule on the following date
properties.notes: Culture short date, optional time in quotes. Clear with $null on Set.

properties.name: ExpiryDate
properties.eac: Deactivate this rule on the following date
properties.notes: Culture short date, optional time in quotes.

properties.name: StopRuleProcessing
properties.notes: Technically an action (listed in Get-TransportRuleAction) but shown as a rule setting in the EAC.

properties.name: Severity
properties.eac: Audit this rule with severity level
properties.notes: Technically an action. DoNotAudit excludes the rule from the transport rule report and message-tracking audit entries. Cmdlet type String.

properties.name: SenderAddressLocation
properties.notes: Envelope matching only affects From, FromMemberOf, FromAddressContainsWords, FromAddressMatchesPatterns, SenderDomainIs (and ExceptIf forms).

properties.name: RecipientAddressType
properties.notes: Cloud only, PowerShell only. Original = address as sent; Resolved = primary SMTP / external address, no proxies.

properties.name: RuleErrorAction
properties.eac: Defer the message if rule processing doesn't complete

properties.name: RuleSubType
properties.notes: Dlp is meaningful only on-premises. Leave None in Exchange Online.

properties.name: UseLegacyRegex
properties.notes: $true = Exchange 2010-compatible regex syntax. Not seen in the Set-TransportRule syntax summary (verify before offering on edit).

properties.name: DlpPolicy
properties.notes: Links the rule to an on-premises DLP policy. Functional only on-premises.
